description: Towellers Limited is a Karachi-based textile exporter founded in 1973 by Shaikh Muhammad Obaid, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and built originally on towel manufacturing. It produces towels, apparel, bedding and baby products, and works to Oekotex, GOTS, GRS, RCS and BCI standards across its processes.
